Binta Lake Recreation Site remains closed until further notice due to significant danger tree risk. The Province is working with Stellat'en Duchun Forestry to address the risk. A plan is in place. The next step is securing funding, which is in progress. The site will remain closed for the 2026 summer season. Please visit nearby recreation sites: Uncha, Binta North, and Indian Bay. If you have any questions, please call Recreation Sites and Trails BC at 250-847-6300. Updates will be posted to: https://www.sitesandtrailsbc.ca/

The parking lot, trails, picnic shelter and other infrastructure remain open, unless otherwise posted on this site.
